claim: Widely available booths reproduce the full tactile experience.
originalWording: Widely available booths reproduce the full tactile experience.

sources.title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: A widely available booth convincingly reproduces whole-body pressure, temperature, texture and wetness.
reference.rationale: Limited vibration/force feedback did not constitute the specified full tactile environment in 2019. Recent finger-scale thermal/pressure research remains materially short of an all-enveloping, all-facet consumer booth.
